## CELL FACTS

Cell 木_正财 (Wood carrying The Steward). Persona The Steward (正财). Definition line: "Methodical, directed acquisition, the value built and kept". Keyword Caution, charge gentle, poles catalyst Security / friction Hoarding. Family function: Action. Cost dimension: value built and kept; counting what others spend freely. Arena: granary, kept things, stone by stone, seasons of saving. Classical portrait: methodical, directed acquisition; value built and kept; caution, thrift, the slow ledger. Ruled domains: Wealth, Savings, Steady love. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 偏财.
Element arena: Wood (trunk, branch, root, grain, growth, the forest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Metal directing Wood cross-polarity — precision shaping reach toward structured outcomes".
- k2_overview: "Your Wood moves as the Steward: growth banked in rings. You build worth the way orchards do, planted early, tended patiently, harvested honestly, replanted always. Assets in your care grow. So do people. Your fortune is cumulative and alive, and it rewards the seasons you refuse to rush."
- k2_functional: "You build annually: steady deposits of effort that quietly become an estate."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Cultivating","Compounding","Deep-rooted"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Wealth":"Your wealth is orchard-shaped: productive assets, patient growth, income in seasons. You like what grows on its own, a skill, a plot, a stake left alone, and you let time do the heaviest lifting. It intends to.","Savings":"You save like a granary: harvests stored against winters. Rotate the stock, reinvest the surplus, and remember granaries exist so that planting can be brave.","Steady love":"You love agriculturally: devotion planted deep, tended daily, expected to fruit for decades. Choose a fellow gardener. Then keep courting through every season, even the mud ones."}

Your energy is all spring and no autumn: everything gets planted, nothing gets brought in, and the finish line remains a rumor from other people’s lives."

Core element Metal, energy element Wood. Law: Metal tames Wood (金克木: the knife prunes the branch). Relative to the core the energy is the tamed, so Wood is this core's Action. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Wood on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Wood as the Action is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: reminder. value.text: Leaving comes hard to you, so you stay on in a place that stopped giving back. Wood asks more of you than your strength covers, which is why you hold on rather than find out what letting go costs. Remember that you pay for the staying every month, in strength the place no longer returns.

value_b.text: Staying put is a choice you make without noticing you made it. Since letting go feels like loss, you keep a place past the point it feeds you rather than risk an empty one. Keep in mind that you are paying for it in months that give nothing back.

value.text: Where you are settled, you stay, and settled is your word for stuck. Because the unknown costs you sleep, you choose the known rather than the new long after it stopped being good for you. Remember that you are allowed to leave something that is only fine, since fine was never what you wanted.

value.text: You stay in a love the way you stay anywhere, well past the point where staying is a choice. Since ending anything feels more like failing than like choosing, you give the person beside you your staying instead of your honesty. value.text: Knowing what something cost matters to you more than enjoying it does. Wood takes more out of you than it puts back, so counting what you have feels safer than using it. Remember that you began counting so you would never feel short, and the counting has never made you feel rich.

value_b.text: You know the price of most things in your life and check it more than once. Since control feels like safety to you, you would rather know what something costs than learn what it is worth. Remember that you count in order to feel safe, and the total has never read safe.

value.text: Where money is involved, you know the number before the feeling. Because being caught short frightens you more than being bored, you spend your attention on the total instead of on the day. It is worth remembering that you meant the number to buy you ease, and ease is what you have not bought.

value.text: Trusting someone takes you years, and losing that trust takes an afternoon. You have more Wood than stamina for it, which puts proof ahead of feeling with anyone new. Remember that you demand proof to avoid being hurt, and the demand is its own small hurt.

value_b.text: Letting someone in takes you years, and you treat the years as the test. Because being let down would cost you more than staying alone, you wait for proof of a person rather than take them on trust. Remember that you wait for a guarantee love never gives, and the waiting costs you love.
